meaning_en: to lash / tie mooring ropes securely to bollard

past.de: Der Seemann vertäute das Tau am Poller
past.en: The sailor secured the mooring line to the bollard

present.de: Er bindet die Leine mit festem Seemannsknoten
present.en: He ties the rope with a steadfast marine knot

imperative.ar: ارْبُطْ بِإِحْكَامٍ يَثْبُتُ أَمَامَ المَدِّ وَالجَزْرِ
imperative.de: Vertäue sicher gegen Ebbe und Flut!
imperative.en: Tie firmly to hold against ebb and tide!
